desk.responsibility: The desks that physically exist. Knows nothing about who booked what.

booking.responsibility: Booking rules: who may take which desk on which date, and cancellation.

availability.responsibility: The only place allowed to know about desks and bookings at once. Answers 'is this desk free'.

shared.responsibility: Cross-cutting configuration only. No domain content, ever.

frontend-booking.responsibility: The desk board: the one screen. States are specified in docs/ux/desk-board.md.

frontend-api.responsibility: The generated client and the types that come from the contract. Nothing hand-written.
